spans.s: युक्त (I) a. (f. क्ता) 1. Primitive, not derived from another word; 2. attentive, absorbed in, meditative; 3. experienced, skilful; 4. active; 5. proper, fit, (with a gen. or loc.); 6. yoked, e.g. भानुः सकृद्युक्ततुरंग एव; 7. accompanied, (pp. of युज् q.v.).
युक्त (II) m. A saint united with the supreme soul.
युक्त (III) n. A team, a yoke.

युक्त (I) a. (f. क्ता) 1. Primitive, not derived from another word; 2. attentive, absorbed in, meditative; 3. experienced, skilful; 4. active; 5. proper, fit, (with a gen. or loc.); 6. yoked, e.g. भानुः सकृद्युक्ततुरंग एव; 7. accompanied, (pp. of युज् q.v.).
युक्त-रूप a. suit, able, proper, fit for, (with a gen. or loc.), जन्म यस्य पुरोर्वंशे युक्तरूपमिदं Sak.i.

युक्ति f. 1. Junction, combination; 2. use, practice; 3. means, expedient; 4. device, contrivance; 5. propriety, fitness; 6. skill, art; 7. inference, argument; 8. probability, enumeration of circumstances (as specification of time, place &c.), असाक्षिकहते चिह्नैर्युक्तिभिश्चागमेन च Yaj.ii.212; 9. connection of incidents in a drama, S.
; 10. emblematic expression of a purpose; 11. arrangement (of words), यत्र खल्वियं वाचोयुक्तिः M.M.i.; 12. sum, total; 13. alloying of metals.
युक्ति-युक्त a. 1. expert, skillful; 2. suitable, fit; 3. proved.
